summary: Verified Electron desktop app addition + web preview regression. All 13 backend pytest tests pass. Web preview loads correctly, window.electronAPI is undefined in browser (no-op), axios uses default HTTP adapter, /api/games returns 200, UI renders game list and 3 tabs. All /app/desktop files present with valid JS syntax; IPC handlers cover all API routes; data-store.js exports all expected CRUD functions; game-launcher.js handles URI + local exe; frontend homepage './' set; desktop node_modules include electron + electron-builder. Electron .exe build not attempted (Linux env, expected).
critical_code_review_comments: main.js handleApiRequest: the /api/daily-records/:id DELETE branch has a dead 'bulk' if/else branch — the 'bulk' case is actually matched separately by /api/daily-records/bulk/delete just below, but the regex ^/api/daily-records/([^/]+)$ will match 'bulk' first if URL were '/api/daily-records/bulk'. Since axios sends DELETE to '/api/daily-records/bulk/delete' (with subpath), regex won't match — logic is OK but the inner 'bulk' guard is dead code and slightly confusing. Consider removing.

data-store.js resetGame uses local Date for 'yesterday' — matches backend behavior, OK. Note completion_rate uses Math.round(x*10000)/100 giving 2 decimals; backend may use different precision — verify parity if needed.
getStats daysDiff computes floor((today - d)/86400000) which can be 0 for same-day and negative if record.date is in future; harmless but note edge case.

Frontend axios adapter override happens synchronously in index.js before render — good. However axios.defaults.adapter is a global mutation; any component that creates its own axios instance BEFORE setupElectronAdapter runs would keep original adapter. Currently no such instances exist, but flag for future maintainers.
seed_data_creation: None; existing StellaSora game already seeded from prior iterations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Electron desktop app cannot be run/built in this Linux env (electron-builder --win requires Windows or wine). Only static verification + web regression is possible here. Web preview uses FastAPI+MongoDB; electronAdapter is a no-op when window.electronAPI is undefined. Desktop code paths (IPC api-request router in main.js, data-store.js JSON persistence, game-launcher.js spawn/shell.openExternal) are unit-testable via Node but not exercised here. If the user reports the Windows .exe misbehaves, ask them to open DevTools in the built app (Ctrl+Shift+I) and share console errors.
